transcript.text: Welcome, everyone. Thanks for coming in today. I'm Mara, and I'll be making the final decision on who gets our Saturday pop-up counter space. Here's what we're working with: the cafe has one counter space available for a Saturday food pop-up from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. I can provide a six-foot counter, access to a hand-washing sink, and ordinary electrical outlets. The selection rule is straightforward — I'll choose the proposal with the greatest upfront payment, and if there's a tie, the greatest quantity wins. Each of you — Luis, Hana, Dev, and Keira — will get one turn to submit your complete formal proposal using the formal reveal action, covering your payment, sales share, menu, quantity, and setup access time. I won't make my decision until all four of you have submitted. So let's get started — who would like to go first?
